slides.alt_text: The BSB text of Exod 17:6: Behold, I will stand there before you by the rock at Horeb. And when you strike the rock, water will come out of it for the people to drink.
slides.body: “Behold, I will stand there before you by the rock at Horeb. And when you strike the rock, water will come out of it for the people to drink.”
slides.heading: Exod 17:6

slides.body: Israel drinks water from a rock at Horeb. Paul later says their spiritual rock 'was Christ'. This connection is explicit in the New Testament.
slides.heading: ‘That rock was Christ’

slides.alt_text: Slide 2: Canonical divine-presence and typological reasoning.
slides.body: God stands by the rock; Israel asks if the LORD is with them. Later biblical poems call God Israel's Rock. Christians read Paul's line as Christ's presence in the wilderness.
slides.heading: A serious Christian case

slides.body: Exodus recounts water for a present emergency; Numbers tells of another rock. Neither names a future Messiah. Paul's canonical identification is strong, but not a standalone forecast.
slides.heading: Was Exodus forecasting?

title: Paul says the rock was Christ
